ACT, SAT or CLT required; take as often as you like, highest scores counted; take by early December (March tests not considered); official scores due Jan 31 of senior year

Required: 1.5-2 hour virtual interview with an Admissions Liaison Officer, scheduled after key checklist items; part of the holistic review
Not applicable: selection based on academics, fitness, medical qualification, character review, interview and a required nomination
No admission by major; cadets may declare from day one but must declare by October of their third semester; 26 disciplinary majors plus divisional majors and minors
Eligibility: U.S. citizen, age 17-22 on July 1 of entry year, unmarried with no dependents

Nomination required: apply to both Senators and your Representative (each office sets its own deadline); Vice Presidential nomination requests due Jan 31; Presidential category reserved for children of career military
Medical: DoDMERB exam required; must meet Air Force commissioning medical and weight standards; waivers possible for highly qualified candidates
Candidate Fitness Assessment required (six events); one retest allowed if time remains
Service commitment: at least 5 years active duty + 3 years inactive reserve; longer for pilots

Application: Pre-Candidate Questionnaire opens March 1 of junior year, due Dec 31 of senior year; candidate checklist opens no earlier than July 1 with an individual deadline; 3 teacher evaluations (English, math, other); 3 essay questions (max 3,000 characters each; 3rd optional but highly recommended)

Gap: the three essay questions (choose 2 of 3 per the Grades 11-12 page; max 3,000 characters) appear only in the applicant portal and were not reviewed. No Common Data Set found for USAFA, so CDS-based C7 data does not exist
